Description.message: Extract the theme colors from the current website and easily check their usage ratio and color codes.

Error_access_chrome_pages.message: Chrome system pages (chrome://) block extensions. Switch to a standard website tab and reopen the popup.

Error_access_chrome_web_store.message: The Chrome Web Store blocks extensions. Open the site you want to analyze in another tab and try again.

Error_access_reload.message: Reload this tab (or open the page in a new tab) so the extension can load, then reopen the popup.

Error_content_script_not_found.message: Couldn't reach the page. Reload it, or confirm the extension is allowed on this site (file URLs/incognito require manual permission).

Error_access_file_pages.message: To analyze local files, enable "Allow access to file URLs" for this extension on chrome://extensions and reload the file.
